Counterparty: Oakfield Logistics GmbH
Effective: 1 September 2018
Term: rolling 12-month periods.

selection_rationale: Clause kind 'assignment_competitor_prohibition' on MSA-OAK-2018 is classified from the contract header (counterparty/term) and the most relevant assignment, change-of-control, exclusivity, or term language in that file.
known_missing_information: Vocabulary does not define whether assignment_competitor_prohibition and competitor_assignment_prohibition are distinct clause kinds or aliases.
